note.details_zh:
• 速度：30 呎
• 選擇一種龍族祖先；祖先決定你的龍息傷害類型、範圍與豁免類型，也使你對該傷害類型具有抗性

龍族血統

| 龍種 | 傷害類型 | 龍息範圍 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 黑龍 | 強酸 | 5 呎寬、30 呎長的直線（敏捷豁免） |
| 藍龍 | 閃電 | 5 呎寬、30 呎長的直線（敏捷豁免） |
| 黃銅龍 | 火焰 | 5 呎寬、30 呎長的直線（敏捷豁免） |
| 青銅龍 | 閃電 | 5 呎寬、30 呎長的直線（敏捷豁免） |
| 赤銅龍 | 強酸 | 5 呎寬、30 呎長的直線（敏捷豁免） |
| 金龍 | 火焰 | 15 呎錐狀（敏捷豁免） |
| 綠龍 | 毒素 | 15 呎錐狀（體魄豁免） |
| 紅龍 | 火焰 | 15 呎錐狀（敏捷豁免） |
| 銀龍 | 寒冷 | 15 呎錐狀（體魄豁免） |
| 白龍 | 寒冷 | 15 呎錐狀（體魄豁免） |

• 使用龍息時，範圍內生物必須進行指定豁免；成功時只承受一半傷害。每次短休或長休後可再次使用
• 語言：通用語、龍語
note.details_en:
• Speed: 30 feet
• Choose a draconic ancestry. It determines your breath weapon's damage type, area, and saving throw, and grants resistance to that damage type

Draconic Ancestry

| Dragon | Damage Type | Breath Weapon |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Black | Acid | 5 by 30 ft. line (Dex. save) |
| Blue | Lightning | 5 by 30 ft. line (Dex. save) |
| Brass | Fire | 5 by 30 ft. line (Dex. save) |
| Bronze | Lightning | 5 by 30 ft. line (Dex. save) |
| Copper | Acid | 5 by 30 ft. line (Dex. save) |
| Gold | Fire | 15 ft. cone (Dex. save) |
| Green | Poison | 15 ft. cone (Con. save) |
| Red | Fire | 15 ft. cone (Dex. save) |
| Silver | Cold | 15 ft. cone (Con. save) |
| White | Cold | 15 ft. cone (Con. save) |

• Creatures in the breath weapon's area make the specified saving throw, taking half damage on a success. You regain its use after a short or long rest
• Languages: Common and Draconic

note.details_zh:
• 速度：25 呎
• 黑暗視覺
• 對抗中毒的豁免具有優勢，且對毒性傷害具有抗性
• 熟練戰斧、手斧、輕錘與戰錘
• 從鐵匠工具、釀酒工具與石匠工具中選擇一項熟練
• 進行與石造物起源有關的智力（歷史）檢定時，視為具有歷史技能熟練，並加上雙倍熟練加值
• 語言：通用語、矮人語
note.details_en:
• Speed: 25 feet
• Darkvision
• Advantage on saving throws against poison and resistance to poison damage
• Proficiency with battleaxes, handaxes, light hammers, and warhammers
• Choose proficiency with smith's tools, brewer's supplies, or mason's tools
• On Intelligence (History) checks related to the origin of stonework, you are considered proficient in History and add twice your proficiency bonus
• Languages: Common and Dwarvish

note.details_zh: • 生命值上限額外 +1；此後每升一級再額外增加 1
note.details_en: • Your hit point maximum increases by 1 and increases by 1 again whenever you gain a level
• You are proficient with light and medium armor

note.details_zh:
• 速度：30 呎
• 黑暗視覺
• 熟練感知（觀察）技能
• 對抗魅惑的豁免具有優勢，且魔法無法使你入睡
• 無須睡眠；每日冥想 4 小時即可獲得等同人類睡眠 8 小時的休息效果，此狀態稱為「出神」（Trance）
• 語言：通用語、妖精語
note.details_en:
• Speed: 30 feet
• Darkvision
• Proficiency in Perception
• Advantage on saving throws against being charmed; magic cannot put you to sleep
• You do not need to sleep. Four hours of daily meditation, called a trance, grants the same benefit a human receives from eight hours of sleep
• Languages: Common and Elvish

note.details_zh:
• 熟練長劍、短劍、短弓與長弓
• 從法師法術表選擇一個戲法；施法能力為智力
• 額外學會一種自選語言
note.details_en:
• Proficiency with longswords, shortswords, shortbows, and longbows
• Choose one cantrip from the wizard spell list; Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for it
• Learn one additional language of your choice

note.details_zh:
• 熟練長劍、短劍、短弓與長弓
• 速度：35 呎
• 在僅受樹葉、大雨、降雪、霧氣或其他自然現象輕度遮蔽時，仍可嘗試躲藏
note.details_en:
• Proficiency with longswords, shortswords, shortbows, and longbows
• Speed: 35 feet
• You can attempt to hide when lightly obscured by foliage, heavy rain, falling snow, mist, or another natural phenomenon

note.details_zh:
• 黑暗視覺範圍增加至 120 呎
• 當你、攻擊目標或你試圖觀察的事物位於陽光直射下時，依賴視覺的攻擊檢定與感知（觀察）檢定具有劣勢
• 會施放「舞光術」（Dancing Lights）戲法。3 級起，每次長休可施放一次「妖火術」（Faerie Fire）；5 級起，每次長休可施放一次「黑暗術」（Darkness）。這些法術的施法能力皆為魅力
• 熟練細劍、短劍與手弩
note.details_en:
• Darkvision extends to 120 feet
• You have disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight when you, your target, or what you are trying to perceive is in direct sunlight
• You know the Dancing Lights cantrip. At 3rd level, you can cast Faerie Fire once per long rest; at 5th level, you can cast Darkness once per long rest. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells
• Proficiency with rapiers, shortswords, and hand crossbows

note.details_zh:
• 速度：25 呎
• 黑暗視覺
• 地侏狡猾：對抗魔法的智力、感知與魅力豁免具有優勢
• 語言：通用語、地侏語；地侏語使用矮人文字書寫
note.details_en:
• Speed: 25 feet
• Darkvision
• Gnome Cunning: Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws against magic
• Languages: Common and Gnomish; Gnomish uses Dwarvish script

note.details_zh:
• 可施放「小幻象」（Minor Illusion）戲法；施法能力為智力
• 可透過聲音與姿勢，向小型或更小的野獸傳達簡單概念
note.details_en:
• You can cast the Minor Illusion cantrip; Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for it
• Through sounds and gestures, you can communicate simple ideas to Small or smaller beasts

note.details_zh:
• 進行與魔法物品、煉金物品或科技裝置有關的智力（歷史）檢定時，加上雙倍熟練加值
• 熟練工匠工具（修補匠工具）。可花費 1 小時與價值 10 gp 的材料，製作能運作 24 小時的微型發條裝置：發條玩具、點火器或音樂盒
note.details_en:
• Add twice your proficiency bonus to Intelligence (History) checks related to magic items, alchemical objects, or technological devices
• Proficiency with artisan's tools (tinker's tools). By spending 1 hour and 10 gp in materials, you can create a Tiny clockwork device that functions for 24 hours: a clockwork toy, fire starter, or music box

note.details_zh:
• 速度：30 呎
• 黑暗視覺
• 妖精血統：對抗魅惑的豁免具有優勢，且魔法無法使你入睡
• 技能多才：熟練兩項自選技能
• 語言：通用語、妖精語，以及一種自選語言
note.details_en:
• Speed: 30 feet
• Darkvision
• Fey Ancestry: Advantage on saving throws against being charmed; magic cannot put you to sleep
• Skill Versatility: Gain proficiency in two skills of your choice
• Languages: Common, Elvish, and one additional language of your choice

note.details_zh:
• 速度：30 呎
• 黑暗視覺
• 熟練魅力（威嚇）技能
• 堅韌不屈：當生命值降至 0，但沒有立即死亡時，可改為剩下 1 點生命值；每次長休後可再次使用
• 凶蠻攻擊：使用近戰武器造成重擊時，可額外擲一次該武器的一顆傷害骰，並加到重擊的額外傷害中
• 語言：通用語、獸人語；獸人語使用矮人文字書寫
note.details_en:
• Speed: 30 feet
• Darkvision
• Proficiency in Intimidation
• Relentless Endurance: When reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 hit point instead. You regain this ability after a long rest
• Savage Attacks: When you score a critical hit with a melee weapon, roll one additional weapon damage die and add it to the critical hit's extra damage
• Languages: Common and Orc; Orc uses Dwarvish script

note.details_zh:
• 速度：25 呎
• 半身人幸運：攻擊檢定、能力檢定或豁免骰擲出 1 時，可重擲該骰一次，並必須採用新的結果
• 勇敢：對抗恐懼的豁免具有優勢
• 半身人靈巧：可穿越體型比你大的生物所占據的空間
• 語言：通用語、半身人語

註：「半身人幸運」與「幸運」專長（Lucky feat）是不同能力。
note.details_en:
• Speed: 25 feet
• Lucky: When you roll a 1 on an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, you can reroll the die once and must use the new result
• Brave: Advantage on saving throws against being frightened
• Halfling Nimbleness: You can move through the space of a creature larger than you
• Languages: Common and Halfling

Note: The halfling's Lucky trait is different from the Lucky feat.

note.details_zh: • 可嘗試躲在體型比你大的生物後方
note.details_en: • You can attempt to hide behind a creature larger than you

note.details_zh: • 對抗中毒的豁免具有優勢，且對毒性傷害具有抗性
note.details_en: • Advantage on saving throws against poison and resistance to poison damage

note.details_zh:
• 速度：30 呎
• 語言：通用語，以及一種自選語言
note.details_en:
• Speed: 30 feet
• Languages: Common and one additional language of your choice

note.basic_zh: 自選兩項不同能力值各+1
note.details_zh:
變體人類以以下特性取代一般人類的能力值提升：

• 熟練一項自選技能
• 獲得一項自選專長（feat）
note.details_en:
The variant human replaces the standard human's ability score increase with the following traits:

• Gain proficiency in one skill of your choice
• Gain one feat of your choice

note.details_zh:
• 速度：30 呎
• 黑暗視覺
• 對火焰傷害具有抗性
• 可施放「奇術」（Thaumaturgy）戲法。3 級起，每次長休可用 2 環施放一次「煉獄叱喝」（Hellish Rebuke）；5 級起，每次長休可施放一次「黑暗術」（Darkness）。這些法術的施法能力皆為魅力
• 語言：通用語、煉獄語
note.details_en:
• Speed: 30 feet
• Darkvision
• Resistance to fire damage
• You can cast the Thaumaturgy cantrip. At 3rd level, you can cast Hellish Rebuke as a 2nd-level spell once per long rest; at 5th level, you can cast Darkness once per long rest. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells
• Languages: Common and Infernal
